name: io.github.doublegate/cyberchef-mcp
description: CyberChef's 504 data-transformation operations -- encryption, encoding, compression, forensics -- as MCP tools, with prompts for common analysis workflows.

environmentVariables.name: CYBERCHEF_TOOL_SURFACE
environmentVariables.description: How many operations appear in tools/list: 'index' (default, ~24 tools), 'curated' (~102) or 'all' (527). Every operation stays reachable via cyberchef_bake regardless.

environmentVariables.name: CYBERCHEF_BINARY_OUTPUT
environmentVariables.description: 'base64' returns non-image binary as base64 instead of the default byte-lossless latin1 text.

environmentVariables.name: CYBERCHEF_RECIPE_STORAGE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the saved-recipe store. Defaults to ./recipes.json in the working directory.
